text.en:
The following subdivisions known as Vergenville, Doña Julita, Doña Paz, St. Joseph, San
Antonio, Martinville and Airmen's Village in Barangay Pulanglupa in the Municipality of Las Piñas, Metro
Manila, is hereby detached and separated therefrom to form and constitute into a distinct and independent
barangay which is created to be known as Barangay Pulanglupa Dos without affecting in any manner the legal
existence of the mother barangay.

Except as hereinafter provided, all provisions of law, now or hereafter applicable to regular
barangays, shall be applicable to Barangay Pulanglupa Dos.

The present elective barangay officials of Barangay Pulanglupa shall continue to perform their
duties as such officials in the newly created Barangay Pulanglupa Dos until the barangay officials of said
barangay shall have been appointed by the President. Such officials so appointed shall hold office until their
successors shall have been elected in the regular elections for barangay officials following the issuance of this
Decree and shall have qualified, unless sooner removed at the pleasure of the President. Such appointive
officers and employees as maybe necessary to organize or complete the government personnel of Barangay
Pulanglupa Dos shall be appointed as provided for under existing laws.

Upon the effectivity of this Decree, the proportionate share of the Barangay Pulanglupa Dos in
the obligations, funds assets and other property of Barangay Pulanglupa shall be transferred by the President
to the newly created barangay upon the recommendation of the Commission on Audit.

All laws or parts of laws as well as all executive orders or regulations, inconsistent herewith are
hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 3rd day of April, in the year of Our Lord Nineteen Hundred and
Seventy-Eight.
